name: Pellucid BioSeal Class-3 Geneware Theater Suit
description:
A full-body cleanroom suit in translucent pearl-white, the outer layer a smooth electrostatically-dissipative film over a sealed microfiber inner shell. The hood is integrated with a clear polycarbonate face shield and a filtered-air collar port. All seams are RF-welded. The suit comes in sealed single-use packaging but is built for up to thirty decontamination cycles before disposal rating drops.

Designed for geneware surgical theaters and high-biosafety genomics labs at Tier 4 facilities. The translucency is functional — supervisors can observe limb positioning and hand placement through the suit during delicate procedures. A fine silver-thread grid woven into the outer film provides passive ESD protection for sensitive genomic equipment.
functionality: ISO Class 3 cleanroom rated. ESD protection via silver-thread grid. Filtered-air collar port compatible with standard lab air supply lines. Hood-integrated face shield with anti-fog inner coating. Rated for 30 decontamination cycles. Translucent outer layer for supervisor observation.
what_it_says: You operate in controlled environments where a single contamination event costs millions and possibly someone's life.
price_range: Φ 340–Φ 680 per unit (bulk lab contract pricing varies)
story_hooks: A Class-3 suit from a geneware theater was found outside the facility with trace biologics inside that don't match any patient or staff DNA on record.
A researcher has been wearing the same suit past its 30-cycle disposal rating for months — she claims the suit's translucency has started showing something that isn't her body underneath.
A shipment of Pellucid suits to a black-market geneware clinic was intercepted — but only half the shipment was recovered.
